CPS - Continuation-Passing Style Async for Nim

A macro-based CPS transformation library that converts normal Nim procedures into async continuations.

Usage: import cps

proc fetchData(url: string): CpsFuturestring {.cps.} = let response = await httpGet(url) return response.body

runCps(fetchData("https://example.com"))
